ROOT_CAUSE:
Eleven branches in RuleBrain answer 'this goal needs the city HUD' by returning OPEN_HOME from the map. Nine close the resource-search panel first; FISHING and BUILDING -- both added after that guard family was written -- did not. The control is BTN_OPEN_HOME, a TEMPLATE node (source_template dataset/candidate/templates/btn_open_home__live_attempt8_idle__3.png), and the beast search sheet is drawn over the map HUD the 回城 door lives on, so on those frames the target genuinely is not on screen and the tap cannot land.

Measured on 2026-10-02, and the split is total rather than statistical:

    OPEN_HOME answered from the map : 69 times, 10 failed
    successes with resource_search_open False : 59/59
    failures  with resource_search_open True  : 10/10
    the 10 failures : FISHING 8 (fishing_entry_requires_city_hud, 0 successes)
                      BUILDING 2 (building_goal_requires_home)
    next step after the failure : BACK/SUCCESS then OPEN_HOME/SUCCESS, on 8 of the 10

So the locator and the verifier were both truthful -- the door really is not drawn -- and the decision was wrong. It tapped a control an open panel was covering, then recovered one step later by exactly the Back the missing guard emits directly. Cost: one wasted step and one false FAILURE per occurrence, and (measured in an earlier round on the camp cluster) this class of false failure is what feeds the STUCK_15_MIN escalation ladder.

REMAINING_ISSUE:
Four.

(a) The guard is per-branch, not structural. The new test makes a twelfth branch impossible to add silently, but the shape is still eleven copies of an if-statement. A single helper would be stronger; it is not done here because it would rewrite nine reason strings, and reason strings are asserted elsewhere (test_beast_map_scan, test_capability_gate).

(b) BUILDING's guard is not yet observed live, only replayed. The window did not reach that route.

(c) The MAA resolver's attribution hole, found while diagnosing this and handed on as WB-1002-15-MAA-NODE-ATTRIBUTION: build_router binds the MAA executor's resolver to a lambda that never passes through the runtime's resolve, and maa_resolver returns None without recording from three branches (the default being the template path). That is exactly the 11 empty-reason navigation misses whose skills all carry an MAA node, against 13 rows from a node-less skill that do carry a reason.

recommended_codex_review: One thing worth your judgement: nine branches guard this panel and two did not, and the test that was supposed to enforce the invariant enumerated the branches that had the guard rather than the branches that emit the decision. That is the second time in three rounds that a test built from its own implementation produced a confident green over a hole (the other was the coverage audit's reason vocabulary). If the pattern is worth a rule, the rule is: when a guard exists for a family, the test must enumerate the family from the decision, not from the guards.
